text:
noah: Hey team—planning a 10-week exchange program in Lisbon (2025-09-01 to 2025-11-09). Keeping my homebase in NYC. Quick Qs: 1) WFH stipend while abroad? 2) Ship extra monitor? 3) Do I need any tax registration? cc @rachel (People Ops)
rachel (People Ops): Hi Noah — usually OK under 90 days but Lisbon trip is 70 days so should be fine. Please open the Temporary Remote form so we can confirm and get shipping approved. DM address + passport country.
marc (Payroll): 70 days <183 days, so US payroll generally stays. Portugal has a 90-day tourist visa limit; tax residency kicks in at 183 days. We'll check for municipal reporting rules — send exact dates and whether you'll meet clients locally.
emma (Benefits): Dependents/partners: if we add your partner to benefits, that can change tax reporting. If you're single on file, short trips don't affect benefits. If you intend to use local healthcare, check our international provider list.
mobility-bot: relocation-case #R-4477 opened for noah — assigned to @rachel. Please upload dates, Lisbon address, equipment list within 48h.
noah: Uploaded details in the case: dates above, address Alfama, passport US, bringing laptop + external monitor. No client meetings, will keep US hours. Partner joining but not on benefits.
rachel (People Ops): Thanks — I'll confirm stipend proration (crosses payroll month?) and shipping ETA. For stipends: we prorate by payroll month boundaries; shipping can be arranged if approved in the case.
marc (Payroll): Running residency & payroll check now. If there are any local reporting flags we'll let you know in the case. Do not change homebase in HR.
emma (Benefits): If you decide to enroll your partner while abroad, ping me — that needs documentation. For short trips, US coverage remains primary; we can share the EU emergency line.
noah: Great — thanks all. Will keep the case updated if anything changes. :thumbsup:
